Initial headless v1 preparation rejected raw pad-list equality because native reload renumbers net codes and may reorder pads. Its board/scripts/invocation are retained. No editor opened for v1.

New v2 preparation separately retains complete before/reloaded native pad records, requires exact UUID-keyed geometry and net names, and records volatile net codes without treating them as portable identity.
Native get_connected_items queries establish copper clusters of these physical primitives, not signal integrity, thermal capacity, ampacity, or PCB readiness.
This is an isolated fixture only. No integration, model call, MCU circuit, manufacturing output, or production code change is claimed.
